Container.Name: gangway
Container.Overview:
gangway gives decks, dashboards and small apps their own HTTPS URL on your domain, from an agent (MCP), a pull request, or a folder dropped in the browser. Previews run as containers on this server's Docker. To keep them in a VM instead, install gangway-inabox.
The defaults put gangway behind a reverse proxy on this server (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG): proxy *.your-domain and your-domain to https://172.17.0.1:8443 with websockets on, and use a wildcard certificate. Without a domain, set Base domain to [server IP with dashes].sslip.io (e.g. 192-168-1-10.sslip.io), Listen address to ::, Public port to 8443 and Share to true, then open https://app.192-168-1-10.sslip.io:8443.
The one-time link that creates the first admin is in this container's log.

Config.Name: Base domain
Config.Description: e.g. preview.example.com; the dashboard is app.preview.example.com and previews get their own names under it.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: 172.17.0.1 (docker0) is where a proxy container in bridge mode reaches gangway. Use :: to answer on every address.

Config.Name: HTTP redirect port
Config.Description: A plain-HTTP listener that redirects to HTTPS. Empty behind a proxy, which redirects itself.

Config.Name: Public port
Config.Description: The port browsers use: 443 behind a proxy, 8443 with no proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Where the proxy connects from; its forwarded headers are believed. Empty with no proxy.

Config.Name: Share links
Config.Description: true turns on public Share links (Cloudflare quick tunnels); empty leaves it to Admin > Server.

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Optional API token with every permission. Empty: create an account from the first-admin link in the log, and tokens under Account.

Config.Name: TLS mode
Config.Description: selfsigned: the proxy holds the real certificate. acme needs the Cloudflare settings in compose.yaml's notes.

Config.Name: Instance
Config.Description: Prefix of the containers gangway makes; unique per gangway on a host.

Config.Name: Orphans
Config.Description: report only logs containers that look like gangway's but that it does not know; stop stops them.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: gangway runs previews as containers on this server.
